solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Passing around legal document or script

indicators.note: around tells us the word for passing wraps itself about the legal document

parts.note: passing something over is handing it
a writ is a legal document ordering an action

explanation.surface: A lawyer circulates either a legal document or a written script.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's script is their style of penmanship, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Instruction to stop book on a saint

parts.note: AV is the Authorised Version, the King James Bible, often clued as book

explanation.surface: An order to halt the publication of a volume about a holy figure.
explanation.walkthrough: The Authorised Version is the King James Bible, a stock crossword 'book'; the answer is a sailors' call.
explanation.definitionFit: The nautical command is a sailor's call meaning halt or cease.

clue.text: Plunder piled so high

indicators.note: high suggests intoxicated, so the letters of piled so are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: Loot is stacked up to a great height.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high' looks like part of the picture of heaped loot but is the anagram signal, slang for drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: To plunder a place is to strip and ravage it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Get back to area in African river flowing North

indicators.note: in places the letter for area within the reversed river
in a down clue a river flowing north is read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: the Niger is a major river of West Africa

explanation.surface: Returning to a region on an African river that runs northwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flowing North' turns NIGER into REGIN, and A goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To regain something is to recover it, a synonym for get back.

clue.text: Shirt and tie designed for time of one's life

indicators.note: designed implies the letters of shirt and tie have been fashioned into something new

explanation.surface: A shirt and tie chosen for a particular age.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's thirties are a decade of their age, a period of their life.

clue.text: Denies Newcastle entrances!

parts.note: NE is the postcode area for Newcastle upon Tyne, in North East England
gates are entrances

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a northern English city refuses entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To negate a claim is to deny or contradict it.

clue.text: Unusually classy and main tax shelter

indicators.note: unusually means the letters of classy and main appear in an uncommon order

explanation.surface: A stylish and principal haven for avoiding tax.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'and' here is fodder, not a link: all thirteen letters are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: This Caribbean territory is a well-known offshore tax haven, an example of the definition.

clue.text: To maintain one's up and working is a form of therapy

parts.note: to aver is to maintain or assert

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the piece is read from bottom to top

parts.note: one's taken as one is, giving I and S
on means working or operating

explanation.surface: Insisting you are active and busy is a kind of treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns IS into SI; 'and' and 'is' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Aversion therapy conditions a patient to dislike a habit, so the word names a type of treatment.

clue.text: Believe story, obtaining financial terms

parts.note: to credit is to believe
an account is a story or narrative

explanation.surface: Trusting a tale that includes money talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A credit account is an arrangement with a shop to buy and pay later, a phrase of finance.

clue.text: Gather there's a service

parts.note: Mass is a church service

explanation.surface: Congregating because a church service is on.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to collect or accumulate.

clue.text: Thorough beating means transferring allegiance

definitions.meaning: a severe thrashing or a thorough examination
switching sides, as in defecting to the other camp

explanation.definitionFit: The hyphenated noun is a beating, while the verb phrase means defecting to another side.

clue.text: Christian's first technique has precedence

indicators.note: has precedence says the technique comes before the next piece

parts.note: a method is a technique
first written as 1st, read with the 1 as the letter I

explanation.surface: A Christian's leading technique takes priority.
explanation.walkthrough: 's is read as 'is', a link. 1ST for first is read as IST.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of the Wesleyan denomination is a member of a Christian church.

clue.text: Attempted shifting resistance to the right, worn out

indicators.note: shifting signals that the resistance letter changes position in the word
to the right shows the resistance letter moves later in the word

parts.note: attempted means tried
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: An effort to move a resistor along left someone exhausted.
explanation.walkthrough: In TRIED the R moves one place right, past the I.
explanation.definitionFit: Being worn out means exhausted or weary, a synonym.

clue.text: Chap returning holding friend's petroleum jelly

indicators.note: holding has the reversed chap enclosing the friend
returning means the word for chap is read backwards

parts.note: a chap is a man
a pal is a friend; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: A man coming back with his friend's petroleum jelly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns MAN into NAM, which holds PAL.
explanation.definitionFit: This incendiary weapon is jellied petrol, so it fits the description.

clue.text: Fish magazine turned up with great effort

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up reads the piece from bottom to top

parts.note: a clip is a magazine of cartridges for a gun
hard means with great effort, as in working hard

explanation.surface: A fishing magazine was hoisted up with much exertion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' makes PILC from CLIP. 'Magazine' looks like a periodical but is the gun's cartridge holder.
explanation.definitionFit: A small oily sea fish, related to the sardine.

clue.text: One of Garibaldi's dithers indecisively crossing river

indicators.note: crossing has the jumbled letters stretch across the river letter
indecisively suggests wavering, so the letters of dithers are unsettled

explanation.surface: An Italian soldier hesitates while fording a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indecisively' rearranges DITHERS, which then goes around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Garibaldi's volunteer soldiers wore red tunics and were named after them.

clue.text: Money just for material

parts.note: cash is money
mere means just or only

explanation.surface: Funds only for fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine soft wool from Kashmir goats, a type of fabric.

clue.text: Rep sleeps outside, full of booze — wow!

indicators.note: full of shows the outside letters holding the drink inside them
outside picks the outermost letters of sleeps

parts.note: ale is booze
man is used as an exclamation, like wow

explanation.surface: A travelling rep sleeps outdoors, drunk, and someone gasps at it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' picks S and S from 'sleeps'; ALE goes between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A rep is a sales representative, so the word is a synonym.

clue.text: Teacher ducks covering chemistry classes originally, getting wind

parts.note: pupils address a male teacher as Sir

indicators.note: covering has the pair of ducks around the initials

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O, so ducks is OO

indicators.note: originally picks the initial letters of chemistry and classes

explanation.surface: A teacher dodges the chemistry lessons and gets a breeze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' gives CC; 'ducks' looks like a verb meaning dodges. 'getting' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot dusty wind blowing from North Africa into southern Europe.

clue.text: Pretty self-contained initially, and somehow nice

indicators.note: initially picks the starting letters of the two parts of self-contained
somehow means the letters of nice are put into some new order

explanation.surface: Attractive, independent, and in some way pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes S and C from 'self' and 'contained'; 'somehow' gives ENIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Scenic describes attractive landscape, a sense of pretty.

clue.text: Exercising caution seeing English in vehicle loaded to capacity

indicators.note: in places the English abbreviation within the vehicle load

parts.note: a carful is as much as a car can hold

explanation.surface: Driving carefully because an Englishman is in an overloaded car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seeing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone careful is cautious and attentive to risk.

clue.text: Problem seeing the writer's work on one article

parts.note: the writer's means belonging to me, so my
op, short for opus, is a work
I is the Roman numeral one
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An author's work rests on one item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Short-sightedness is an eye condition, a problem with vision.

clue.text: Hate having a house briefly in Britain

indicators.note: in puts the shortened house inside the British abbreviation

parts.note: HO is the short form of house

explanation.surface: Resenting owning a home in Britain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To abhor something is to loathe or detest it.

clue.text: The osprey flies as if by magic

indicators.note: flies suggests the letters of the osprey take off and scatter

explanation.surface: A bird of prey takes off seemingly by enchantment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flies' reads naturally for a bird but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The conjuror's exclamation announces a trick, used to mean suddenly and magically.

clue.text: Deposit of mineral aggregate beneath street

indicators.note: beneath places the mineral below the street in a down clue

parts.note: ore is a natural aggregate of minerals

explanation.surface: A seam of mineral lies under a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To store something is to deposit it for safekeeping.

clue.text: Scandal about wreck being a bargain

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase used predicatively; the answer is an adjective phrase meaning very inexpensive

parts.note: dirt is scandalous gossip
C, short for circa, means about
a heap is an old wreck of a car

explanation.surface: A scandal over a wrecked car turns out to be a good deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being' is a link word; C is circa, about.
explanation.definitionFit: Something extremely cheap is a real bargain, a near-synonym.

clue.text: Disheartened fool has finished early and done a bunk

indicators.note: disheartened removes the heart of fool, leaving its outer letters
finished early cuts the last letter off the word for has

parts.note: owns means has

explanation.surface: A dejected idiot leaves work early and runs off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' leaves FL; OWNS loses its end to give OWN.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing a bunk is British slang for running away, so the word means fled.

clue.text: Jumper for European royal outside strongroom

parts.note: a Pole is a European from Poland
a vault is a strongroom
ER, Elizabeth Regina, denotes royalty

explanation.surface: A sweater for a European royal kept outside a bank vault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumper' suggests a sweater, a British word for one, but means an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: This athlete jumps over a bar using a pole, so is a jumper.
